title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits: Spend Supplement to the Purchase Allowance
content:
Ashbury Rewards members with high qualifying spend may buy more points. The qualifying spend of the twelve months is the eligible spend of the base points transactions posted in those months less the eligible spend removed by the stay credit reversals posted in them; a qualifying spend of ten thousand US dollars or more adds a spend supplement of ten thousand points to the base of the purchase allowance, five thousand to nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine dollars and ninety-nine cents adds five thousand points, and a lower spend adds none. The purchase allowance is the base plus the spend supplement, never more than the points purchase annual cap of the tier; the cap is applied after the supplement is added.

| Qualifying spend in the twelve months | Spend supplement added to the base |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 USD or more | 10000 points |
| 5000.00 to 9999.99 USD | 5000 points |
| Below 5000.00 USD | None |

The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Eligible spend on base points transactions in the window | Spend removed by stay credit reversals in the window | Qualifying spend | Supplement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10120.00 | 120.00 | 10000.00 | 10000 points |
| 10120.00 | 120.01 | 9999.99 | 5000 points |
| 5000.00 | 0.00 | 5000.00 | 5000 points |
| 5040.00 | 40.01 | 4999.99 | None |
